findings.passage: Blake passed the law banning Big Tech private funding from interfering in Louisiana elections. Voter ID, proof of citizenship, and no foreign money running our elections. Congress needs to pass the SAVE America Act and get it to the President’s desk. Only American citizens should be deciding American elections. If people don’t trust the process, nothing else matters.
findings.note: Election Integrity item on his campaign issues page. Names voter ID, proof of citizenship and passing the SAVE America Act. Date is the day the page was fetched; the page itself is undated.
subjects: foreign and private money in elections

findings.note: Listed among the senators on the byline of SB 436 (Act 500 of 2024), which requires proof of United States citizenship with a voter registration application. Lead author is Sen. Fesi; he is one of the listed co-authors. Enrolled as Act 500.

Listed among the senators on the byline of HB 691 (Act 6 of 2026), which sends state voter information to the federal SAVE program and has the election integrity division investigate registered voters who may be non-citizens. Lead author is Rep. Beaullieu; he is one of the listed senate co-authors.
